step.label: Identify hazardous substances in operations
step.description: Review and catalog all hazardous materials currently used in manufacturing and facility operations.
step.useCase: Safety managers need to maintain an accurate inventory of hazardous substances for regulatory compliance and employee protection.

step.label: Assess employee safety exposure and compensation impact
step.description: Evaluate workforce members exposed to hazardous substances and determine if compensation adjustments or hazard pay is warranted.
step.useCase: HR departments must ensure employees working with hazardous materials receive appropriate compensation for elevated risk.

step.label: Plan safety equipment maintenance and upgrades
step.description: Request changes and service tickets for protective equipment and engineering controls needed to mitigate hazardous substance exposure.
step.useCase: Facility managers need to schedule maintenance and upgrades to protective systems that safeguard employees from hazardous substances.

step.label: Order compliant safety materials from vendors
step.description: Create purchase orders with qualified vendors for safety equipment and supplies that meet regulatory compliance standards.
step.useCase: Procurement teams must source compliant safety materials from pre-qualified vendors to ensure regulatory adherence.

step.label: Manage employee time-off for safety training and recovery
step.description: Process time-off requests and balance entitlements for employees attending mandatory safety training or recovering from hazard-related incidents.
step.useCase: HR systems need to track and approve time-off for safety training and medical recovery without impacting operational schedules.

step.label: Coordinate product and material changes for safety
step.description: Align engineering changes and material substitutions with safety requirements to eliminate or reduce hazardous substances in products.
step.useCase: Sales and engineering teams must collaborate to introduce safer product variants that meet customer and regulatory safety expectations.

step.label: Execute customer safety programs and regulatory reporting
step.description: Launch safety campaigns and prepare regulatory documentation communicating hazard controls and compliance status to customers and authorities.
step.useCase: Compliance and marketing teams need to demonstrate safety commitment through customer programs and timely regulatory disclosures.

step.label: Review employee safety performance and competency
step.description: Evaluate employee performance against safety competencies and hazardous substance handling protocols as part of performance review cycles.
step.useCase: HR teams need to incorporate safety performance and compliance competencies into employee evaluations to reinforce safety culture.
